description_en: Submits a remediation task for risky check items in cloud product configuration checks, or rolls back a remediation task that has been executed
description_zh: 云产品配置检查中提交存在风险检查项的修复任务或回滚已经执行的修复任务
name: SubmitOperationTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the check item.

Call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to obtain the check item ID
parameters.help_zh:
检查项的ID。

您可调用[ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~)接口获取检查项ID
parameters.name: check_id

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the server
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The region ID of the server
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The task ID to roll back when performing a rollback task
fields.help_zh: 回滚任务时回滚的任务ID
fields.name: task_id

fields.help_en:
The asset vendor. Valid values:

0: Alibaba Cloud asset
1: asset outside the cloud
2: IDC asset
3, 4, 5, 7: asset from another cloud provider
8: lightweight asset
fields.help_zh:
资产厂商。取值：

0：阿里云资产
1：云外资产
2：IDC资产
3、4、5、7：其它云资产
8：轻量级资产
fields.name: vendor

parameters.help_en: The asset information required to submit instance tasks
parameters.help_zh: 提交实例任务所需的资产信息
parameters.name: operation_task_instances

parameters.help_en:
The task dimension for the submitted operation task. Valid values:
INSTANCE: instance dimension
CHECK_ID: check item dimension
parameters.help_zh:
提交操作任务的任务维度：
实例维度：INSTANCE
检查项维度：CHECK_ID
parameters.name: dimension_type

parameters.help_en:
The task type for the submitted task. Valid values:
REPAIR: remediation task
ROLLBACK: rollback task
parameters.help_zh:
提交任务的任务类型：
修复任务：REPAIR
回滚任务：ROLLBACK
parameters.name: type

fields.help_en: The name of the temporary remediation parameter
fields.help_zh: 对应临时修复参数的名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value of the temporary remediation parameter
fields.help_zh: 临时修复参数对应的值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The temporary parameters required for the remediation task
parameters.help_zh: 修复任务需要的临时参数
parameters.name: repair_temp_param

parameters.help_en:
The relation key associated with cross-page selection when submitting the operation.
Call the [CreateAssetSelectionConfig](~~CreateAssetSelectionConfig~~) operation and use the BusinessType field to obtain the relation key
parameters.help_zh:
提交操作时关联跨页选择的关联Key。
您可调用[CreateAssetSelectionConfig](~~CreateAssetSelectionConfig~~)接口BusinessType字段获取关联Key
parameters.name: relation_key

OperateCode.description_en:
The result code returned by the operation. Valid values:
AuthorizationExhaust: Insufficient authorization.
ActionTrialUnauthorized: Unauthorized
OperateCode.description_zh:
处理返回的结果码：
授权不足：AuthorizationExhaust
未授权：ActionTrialUnauthorized

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RootTaskId.description_en: The root task ID returned after the task is submitted
RootTaskId.description_zh: 提交任务返回的主任务ID
